facts.fact: According to Think With Google (a third-party source cited by the page), one in four app users discovers an app through search.
facts.quote: one in four app users discovers an app through search

facts.fact: Per the page, Google's app-only content indexing test applied only to Android apps and to searches on Android phones.
facts.quote: it is only Android apps and for searches on Android phones.

facts.fact: Per the page, in Chrome, users see app-only content results only for apps they have already downloaded.
facts.quote: if users are searching in Chrome, they will only see the app-only content results for those apps which they have already downloaded.

facts.fact: Per the page, Android Nearby notifications require the user to opt in by turning on Bluetooth and Location.
facts.quote: Users have the choice to opt in to receiving these notifications by turning on Bluetooth and Location.

facts.fact: Per the page, setting up an Android app for Nearby requires investing in Eddystone Beacons configured to point to the desired experience.
facts.quote: you will need to invest in some Eddystone Beacons which you then configure to point to your desired experience.
